entries: An Organization is the group formed around a VIP or CEO. The leader can recruit Associates and run Organization work, business activities, and other CEO-related content.
Associates are players recruited into a CEO's Organization. Rockstar's CEO system gives Associates group benefits while they help with Organization and cargo work.
Headhunter is VIP/CEO Work where the Organization must eliminate multiple marked targets before the timer expires.
Haulage is VIP/CEO Work built around collecting a large trailer and delivering it to a destination while other players may interfere.
Airfreight is VIP/CEO Work in which the Organization uses a Cargobob to recover and deliver an objective.
Motorcycle Clubs can assign members roles such as Prospect, Enforcer, Sergeant at Arms, Road Captain, and Vice President. These roles can provide different club abilities.
MC Riding Formation creates a formation area around the leader. Eligible members riding together can receive player and vehicle health regeneration benefits.
Club Work is Motorcycle Club Freemode content. Rockstar introduced activities such as MC Deathmatch, Joust, and Caged In alongside other club challenges and contracts.
Classic MC businesses require setup and supplies to produce stock. Product can then be sold, while equipment, staff, and security upgrades affect operation and risk.
MC businesses offer Equipment, Staff, and Security upgrades. Equipment and Staff improve production, while Security is intended to reduce raid risk.
Bunker staff can be assigned through Disruption Logistics to production, Research, or a split depending on the selected management setup. Research unlocks Gunrunning-related technology over time.
The Gunrunning business uses supplies to generate stock or support Research. Resupply and Sell operations are managed from the Bunker's Disruption Logistics computer.
The MOC has configurable trailer bays. Rockstar lists options including Weapon Workshop, Weapon & Vehicle Workshop, Personal Vehicle Storage, Living Quarters, and Command Center.

Mobile Operations are missions launched from a configured MOC. Rockstar tied access to completing required Bunker Resupply Missions, with trade-price benefits for featured weaponized vehicles after completion.

The Diamond Casino & Resort is a shared GTA Online location with casino activities and guest services. Some features and gambling access can vary by region or platform rules.
Owning a Casino Penthouse provides VIP membership and access to Casino Story Missions and related Freemode content.
GTA Online includes collectible sets across the map. Rockstar added Interaction Menu tracking for certain collectible progress, such as Hidden Playing Cards.
The Diamond Casino Heist uses Prep work before the finale. Players choose an approach, can hire crew members, and can complete additional Prep work to improve available equipment or options.
The Big Con is one of the three Diamond Casino Heist approaches. It focuses on deception and disguise rather than simply entering with maximum force.
Silent & Sneaky is the stealth-focused Diamond Casino Heist approach, built around avoiding or controlling detection during the robbery.
Aggressive is the combat-focused Diamond Casino Heist approach. It trades stealth and deception for a direct assault-oriented finale.
Auto Shop Contracts are robbery-style Jobs. Rockstar describes them as two planning missions in Freemode followed by a finale.

Auto Shop owners can receive customer cars, repair and modify them to the requested specification, then deliver them personally or use hired staff where available.
After the required Auto Shop progression, Exotic Exports provides a list of vehicles to find in Freemode and deliver for rewards.
LS Car Meet has its own Reputation progression. Rockstar uses Car Meet Reputation for access to selected rewards, clothing, wheels, and vehicle-related content.
